verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK, so x86 SIMD acceleration is a fair question for it. The evidence only makes generic claims, such as being "accelerated by whatever silicon the device has" and validating kernels against the silicon they run on. The concrete hardware it names is the Snapdragon Hexagon NPU and Apple Metal GPUs, and nothing mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any x86 CPU optimization.
